name: A Midsummer Ghost Story
source:
The ghost had always been ignored by everyone. He lived his entire life like that— observing fish tank and as people come and go, rinse and repeat, every single day. That was until a boy somewhat managed to see him one day...?

Not letting the chance to slip, the ghost decided to tease the boy until his existence is acknowledged!

[From [url=https://imamaism.itch.io/a-midsummer-ghost-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那只幽灵向来被所有人视若无睹。他这一辈子都是这样过来的——盯着鱼缸发呆，看着人们来来往往，日复一日，周而复始。直到某一天，一名少年不知怎的竟然看见了他……？

绝不放过这千载难逢的机会，幽灵决定好好捉弄一番这名少年，直到对方承认自己的存在为止！

[摘自[url=https://imamaism.itch.io/a-midsummer-ghost-story]itch.io[/url]]
